summary: The maintained tend S3 rule moves a Delivery from Backlog, Ready or In progress to In review when it has a strictly linked open non-draft PR. S3b moves Backlog or Ready to In progress when the strictly linked open PR population is draft-only. These predicates use native linkage, PR state and draft state; they do not establish a live worker, reviewer activity or process heartbeat. The Status lifecycle contract still requires Root to reconcile the whole scoped promise at execution, review, supplier and acceptance boundaries. An automatic projection can therefore outlive the activity that initially justified it. O1 rolls up a complete child Status population to limited parent planning states; parent and Delivery Status counts are not concurrent-worker counts. Refresh actual owner, operation and reviewer evidence before making an activity claim. This source finding authorizes no Status change, dispatch or reservation release.
title: Board Status follows native PR and child state, not worker concurrency
